lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਰਤ ਲੋਕ ਪਇਆਲ ਸਮੀਪਤ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਥਾਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਭਗਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: mirat lok paiaal sameepat asathir thaan jis hai abhagaa ||12||
lines.translation: He is near this world and the nether regions of the underworld; His Place is permanent, ever-stable and imperishable. ||12||
The Purifier of sinners, the Destroyer of pain and fear.
The Eliminator of egotism, the Eradicator of coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਤੋਖਿਤ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਗੁਣੇ ਨ ਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਭਿਗਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatee tokhit deen kripaalaa gune na kit hee hai bhigaa ||13||
lines.translation: He is pleased with devotional worship, and merciful to the meek; He cannot be appeased by any other qualities. ||13||
The Formless Lord is undeceivable and unchanging.
He is the Embodiment of Light; through Him, the whole world blossoms forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: so milai jis aap milaae aapahu koi na paavaigaa ||14||
lines.translation: He alone unites with Him, whom He unites with Himself. No one can attain the Lord by himself. ||14||
He Himself is the milk-maid, and He Himself is Krishna.
He Himself grazes the cows in the forest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: aap upaavahi aap khapaavahi tudh lep nahee ik til ra(n)gaa ||15||
lines.translation: You Yourself create, and You Yourself destroy. Not even a particle of filth attaches to You. ||15||
Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I chant with my one tongue?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਸੇਖ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahas phanee sekh a(n)t na jaanai ||
lines.translation: Even the thousand-headed serpent does not know Your limit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: navatan naam japai din raatee ik gun naahee prabh kahi sa(n)gaa ||16||
lines.translation: One may chant new names for You day and night, but even so, O God, no one can describe even one of Your Glorious Virtues. ||16||
I have grasped the Support, and entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Father of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਦੁਤਰ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bhaiaanak jamadoot dutar hai maaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death is terrifying and horrendous, and sea of Maya is impassable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਇਛਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: hohu kripaal ichhaa kar raakhahu saadh sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g sa(n)gaa ||17||
lines.translation: Please be merciful, Lord, and save me, if it is Your Will; please lead me to join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||17||
All that is seen is an illusion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik maagau daan gobid sa(n)t renaa ||
lines.translation: I beg for this one gift, for the dust of the feet of the Saints, O Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗਾ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: masatak laai param pad paavau jis praapat so paavaigaa ||18||
lines.translation: Applying it to my forehead, I obtain the supreme status; he alone obtains it, unto whom You give it. ||18||
Those, unto whom the Lord, the Giver of peace, grants His Mercy,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਲੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin saadhoo charan lai ridai paraate ||
lines.translation: grasp the feet of the Holy, and weave them into their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: sagal naam nidhaan tin paaiaa anahad sabad man vaaja(n)gaa ||19||
lines.translation: They obtain all the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates and resounds within their minds. ||19||
With my tongue I chant the Names given to You.
'Sat Naam' is Your perfect, primal Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak bhagat pae saranaaee dehu daras man ra(n)g lagaa ||20||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, Your devotees have entered Your Sanctuary. Please bestow the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; their minds are filled with love for You. ||20||
You alone know Your state and extent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape kathahi tai aap vakhaanahi ||
lines.translation: You Yourself speak, and You Yourself describe it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਾਸਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas daasan ko kareeahu har bhaavai daasaa raakh sa(n)gaa ||21||2||11||
lines.translation: Please make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, O Lord; as it pleases Your Will, please keep him with Your slaves. ||21||2||11||
Maaroo, Fifth Mehl:
O slave of the inaccessible Lord God Allah,
forsake thoughts of worldly entanglements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੈ ਖਾਕ ਫਕੀਰ ਮੁਸਾਫਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ਦਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hoi pai khaak phakeer musaaphar ihu daraves kabool daraa ||1||
lines.translation: Become the dust of the feet of the humble fakeers, and consider yourself a traveller on this journey. O saintly dervish, you shall be approved in the Court of the Lord. ||1||
Let Truth be your prayer, and faith your prayer-mat.
Subdue your desires, and overcome your hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਣਾ ਕਲਮ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਪਾਕੁ ਖਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: deh maseet man maulaanaa kalam khudaaee paak kharaa ||2||
lines.translation: Let your body be the mosque, and your mind the priest. Let true purity be God's Word for you. ||2||
Let your practice be to live the spiritual life.
Let your spiritual cleansing be to renounce the world and seek God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਫਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹੁ ਅਬਦਾਲਾ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਹਕੀਕਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maaraphat man maarahu abadaalaa milahu hakeekat jit phir na maraa ||3||
lines.translation: Let control of the mind be your spiritual wisdom, O holy man; meeting with God, you shall never die again. ||3||
Practice within your heart the teachings of the Koran and the Bible;
restrain the ten sensory organs from straying into evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਮਰਦ ਸਿਦਕਿ ਲੇ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਬੂਰੀ ਕਬੂਲ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch marad sidak le baadhahu khair sabooree kabool paraa ||4||
lines.translation: Tie up the five demons of desire with faith, charity and contentment, and you shall be acceptable. ||4||
Let compassion be your Mecca, and the dust of the feet of the holy your fast.
Let Paradise be your practice of the Prophet's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੂਰ ਨੂਰ ਮੁਸਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਅਲਹ ਆਲਾ ਹੁਜਰਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: hoor noor musak khudaaiaa ba(n)dagee alah aalaa hujaraa ||5||
lines.translation: God is the beauty, the light and the fragrance. Meditation on Allah is the secluded meditation chamber. ||5||
